stemMd: What does “average the memories” mean figuratively?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Combine conflicting accounts into one flattened compromise narrative.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Measure the square’s area in metres.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Record each interview at the same audio volume.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Remove every photograph from the exhibition.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Calculate the mean age of all narrators.

explanationMd: The project refuses to collapse distinct experiences into a single supposedly neutral account. “Average” is a metaphor for smoothing away differences. Preserving contrasts is central to the exhibition’s purpose.

distractorRationale.e: The phrase concerns the stories rather than the narrators’ ages.
distractorRationale.c: The issue is interpretation, not sound levels.
distractorRationale.d: Photographs remain part of the presentation.
